summary: Standardize the Mini Buzdolabı nominal dimensions from 45x43x66 cm to 50x50x66 cm across catalog, runtime state, automatic-depot composition, persistence expectations, placement footprint, rendering inputs, and targeted browser coverage.

impactAnalysis.notes: The dimension change is intentionally isolated from F-011. F-019 is affected because Mini Buzdolabı dimensions are currently duplicated across catalog/state/composition, but this PR does not claim to close the broader F-019 finding. Placement and rendering algorithms are unchanged; their inputs change from a 45x43 footprint to 50x50. Existing persisted project instances retain their stored dimensions; newly created/reconstructed Mini Buzdolabı modules use 50x50x66.

e2e.reason: The nominal footprint changes browser-visible drag placement, collision bounds, rendered scale inputs, and persisted module dimensions, so a real Chromium catalog drag-and-save regression is required.

risk.notes: The 5 cm width and 7 cm depth increase changes the Mini Buzdolabı footprint used by free placement and automatic-depot composition. The height remains 66 cm and no placement algorithm or persisted schema is changed.

migration.notes: No project-state schema changes. Existing saved Mini Buzdolabı instances keep their stored dimensions; newly created/reconstructed instances use the new 50x50x66 nominal dimensions. A global historical-state migration would belong to the separate project migration work rather than this dimension update.

rollback: Revert the Mini Buzdolabı catalog/state/depot dimension commits and targeted regressions if the 50x50 footprint causes an unacceptable placement or composition regression.
